description: React component for the 'Moments' feature in a web application, allowing users to enable/disable photo capturing, select tags, and take photos using webcam or mobile camera.

classes.name: Props
classes.description: Type for component props, containing a WebApplication instance.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables the Moments feature if the user is entitled; otherwise prompts for premium.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the Moments feature on or off.

methods.name: takePhoto
methods.description: Triggers the photo capture process if user is entitled.

methods.name: selectTag
methods.description: Sets the default tag for Moments.

methods.name: unselectTag
methods.description: Clears the default tag for Moments.
